user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the floating menu links so that I can access different sections of the application easily.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click on the 'Home' link, I should remain on the same page, and the URL should not change.
2. When I click on the 'News' link, I should remain on the same page, and the URL should not change.
3. When I click on the 'Contact' link, I should remain on the same page, and the URL should not change.
4. When I click on the 'About' link, I should remain on the same page, and the URL should not change.
5. When I click on the 'Elemental Selenium' link, I should be redirected to 'http://elementalselenium.com/'.
